answers.core: Rich Text in Output is already supported in core via print_rich, but the hyperlinks don't work, subverting user expectation. This feature would also improve workflow for all users of Godot via print_debug and print_rich in an unobtrusive way.
answers.workaround: I cannot guarantee users would often use hyperlinks with print_rich, but users would often receive the benefit when they use print_debug and print_stack. As far as I know, there is not a simple workaround to achieve this other than deliberately using push_warning, which is bad form for something which should not be a warning.

title: Add hyperlink capabilities to Output tab with BBCode
